profile.description:
MiMo V2.6 Pro is Xiaomi's flagship open-source reasoning model for complex projects, long-horizon agent tasks, cybersecurity, research, and high-value professional work. It natively understands text, images, video, and audio, supports a 1M-token context window and up to 128K output tokens, and provides controllable deep thinking, tool calling, JSON mode, streaming, and prompt caching.

File Support: Text, Markdown, Image, Video and PDF files
Context window: 1M tokens
